text:
elaine: quick sync on the FinCloud POC — they want a 3-week eval, EU data residency, and an SLA-like perf target. can we confirm hosting recommendation?
raj: short answer: prefer Dedicated EU for predictable throughput and EUD compliance. Hosted in eu-west also works if they accept shared tenancy.
elaine: high level ask from customer: 1) latency p95 < 300ms for 1k-token context, 2) sustain 25 req/s steady state, 3) end-to-end cost < $0.08 per 1k tokens. also need answers for security questionnaire about KMS and audit logs.
samir: @elaine for the perf targets we need to know model family + typical prompt lengths. Dedicated sizing suggestion: 4xA10G for the workload if they use a larger LLM; 2x for a quantized 13B. can we get sample prompts?
elaine: yes i asked for 50 prompts, plus 5 evals (intent extraction, reranking, summarization). they'll share tomorrow.
raj: POC plan idea: week1 onboarding + smoke (simple hosted run in eu-west), week2 dedicated run + load test, week3 evals and tuning. this lets us show both hosted and Dedicated economics.
jules: pricing Q from buyer: will they be allowed to burst above committed for Dedicated and how billed?
raj: Dedicated has burst pool option — billable at on-demand rate for bursts; we can propose a short-term reserved commit for the POC to cap costs. i'll draft numbers after we pick instance type.
gordon: security notes — FinCloud requires: customer-managed KMS, audit logs retained 13 months, SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, and optional private deployment (VPC) if they have strict egress rules. Hosted in eu-west + customer KMS is doable, but for air-gapped controls they'd need Redwood Private.
elaine: they also asked whether tokens are stored. answer: we never persist customer prompts by default; we can enable request-level logging for the POC with consent.
samir: quick config snippet for Dedicated test (for presales doc):
```
deploy_mode: dedicated
region: eu-west-1
pool_size: 4
model: gpt-open-13b-quant
autoscale: enabled
burst_pool: enabled
commit_term: monthly
```
samir: running load test we should target 30 rps to include headroom. use continuous batching and prefix KV cache for their summarization flows.
jules: what about fallback if Dedicated capacity is exhausted during POC? customer cares about availability.
raj: route policy: primary -> Dedicated eu-west, fallback -> Hosted eu-west with model variant (lower-cost quantized). show cost/latency tradeoff in demo.
gordon: security-team request: i'll need the questionnaire PDF filled. @elaine please get the form and the legal contact. i can prefill most answers.
elaine: will do. they gave an initial timelines constraint: contract signed in 2 weeks, POC start 3 days after. tight but doable if we accelerate onboarding.
jules: ok for handoff — can we get an engineer for an onboarding call next Wed?
samir: i can do Tue morning or Wed afternoon.
elaine: booked Wed 10:30 with FinCloud. i've attached the meeting link in calendar.
raj: next steps for presales doc: 1) get 50 prompts 2) confirm model choices 3) fill security questionnaire 4) draft cost estimates for hosted vs dedicated vs private 5) run smoke in hosted before Dedicated.
elaine: all noted. any blockers?
gordon: one probable blocker: if their legal requires data to never leave customer VPC, we'll have to pivot to Private — that adds 2 weeks for infra prep. flagging now. :warning:
jules: ok flag accepted. i'll add that to the risk register and include mitigation (prelim Private checklist).
deploy-bot: Deploy check: POC sandbox namespace created: redwood-poc-fincloud-eu-west (id: poc-8943). logs and metrics auto-enabled. :rocket:
elaine: perfect — thanks team. i'll upload prompts and the questionnaire when i get them, and post updates here. :thumbsup:
